text.p: Following are the main stories in Croatian newspapers on Tuesday.
- Salaries to go up 8 to 10 percent, said finance minister Bozo Prka.
- 200 bodies unearthed from the Ovcara mass grave near Vukovar.
- Is the opposition alliance in Zagreb to break up?
- Baranja Serbs seeking special status within Croatia.
- New nuclear power plants to be built after the year 2010.
- Total work force in Croatia estimated at 1.16 million people in August, down 2.3 percent from August last year.
- Council of Europe seminar on new types of crime currently being held in Zagreb. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
